selection_data: event-grouped nested cross-validation on released competition training data

target_finger_movement_state_head.description: The same residual LSTM state predicts trajectory and a balanced target-finger movement/rest logit. The direct LARS path remains fixed.

excluded_invalid_ablation: A cached-feature-only run cannot exercise interlevel wavelet paths and is excluded. The runner now rejects that configuration.
visual_diagnostic: The state head lowered stationary offset and enlarged several movement peaks, but retained isolated false peaks and substantially underestimated the two largest flexions.
decision: Keep the auxiliary state head and the interlevel paths experimental. The state head gives a small consistent improvement but remains below the requested 0.1 PCC gain; valid end-to-end normalization is rejected by two inner folds and reduces stitched held-out PCC when selected in the third.
